14e4:4331.name: Broadcom BCM4331 802.11a/b/g/n
14e4:4331.why: b43 is 2.4GHz-only on this PHY; the vendor wl driver loads wlp2s0 but never scans/associates on Fedora 43 kernel 7.2.8 (unmaintained STA driver).
mitigations: move the AP off a crowded 2.4GHz channel and force 20MHz
disable NetworkManager background scanning and powersave
use a USB WiFi adapter with an in-kernel driver (mt7921u/ath9k_htc/rtw88)
